text:
Residents:
Felix (30s) and Aisha (40s) work in town. Weekdays: out 8:00–17:30, home evenings. Weekends: sleep in, errands midday, home rest of day. Hobbies: Felix (knitting, movies, family calls); Aisha (running, houseplants, movies, family calls).

Object Locations & Routines:
Most items remain in their Tuesday 18:00 walkthrough locations. Key changes observed on Sunday:

Entry:
- Aisha’s items (backpack, headphones, jacket, keys, lunchbox, notebook, pen, scarf, shoes, wallet, water bottle) are out during the day and returned to entry by 20:00.
- Felix’s items (backpack, charger, headphones, jacket, laptop, scarf, keys, wallet, shoes, water bottle) are out during the day and returned to entry by 20:00.
- Shared: toolbox, vacuum cleaner on floor.
- Aisha’s running shoes move from shoe rack to entry floor in late afternoon (19:44) before returning.

Kitchen:
- Counter: kettle, knife block, toaster, wall clock, vitamins (Felix).
- Cupboard: duster, glass (Aisha), lunchbox (Aisha), bowl (Aisha), bowl (Felix), mug (Aisha), mug (Felix), plate (Aisha), plate (Felix), serving dish, snack bowl.
- Table: fruit bowl, water bottle (Felix).
- Sink: soap dispenser, toothbrush holder, cutting board, kitchen knife, pan, spatula.
- Dish rack: glass (Aisha), water bottle (Aisha).
- Drawer: empty.
- Pantry: shopping bag.
- Note: Kitchen items (dishes, utensils, water bottles) cycle between cupboard, table, sink, and dish rack during meal prep and cleanup. By 20:32, most items returned to cupboard or table.

Living:
- Couch: blanket, cushion 1, knitting bag (Felix).
- Coffee table: candle, coasters, tissue box.
- Bookshelf: board game, picture frame, speaker, vase.
- TV stand: remote (shared).
- Side table: lamp.
- Armchair: cushion 2.

Bedroom 1:
- Nightstand: books (Aisha, Felix), glasses (Aisha), tablets (Aisha, Felix), phone (Aisha), phone (Felix), headphones (Aisha).
- Desk: laptop (Aisha), laptop (Felix), headphones (Felix), charger (Felix), notebook (Aisha), pen (Aisha).
- Dresser: hair dryer (Felix).
- Floor: ironing board.
- Bed: empty.
- Wardrobe: empty.
- Note: Aisha’s headphones move between nightstand, desk, and bed. Felix’s phone moves between dresser, entry floor, and nightstand.

Bathroom:
- Shelf: detergent, laundry basket, skincare (Aisha), skincare (Felix).
- Medicine cabinet: medication (Aisha).
- Sink: soap dispenser, toothbrush holder, razor (Felix), razor (Aisha).
- Towel rack: towels (Aisha, Felix).
- Note: Skincare items moved from medicine cabinet to shelf at 12:00.

Balcony:
- Floor: watering can.
- Table: spray bottle, gardening gloves.

Office:
- All spots empty.

Notes:
- Aisha’s and Felix’s work/errand items (laptops, bags, keys, phones, etc.) are typically out during the day and returned to entry by evening.
- Phones are left in living/bedroom when home, taken out when leaving.
- Remote moves between TV stand and coffee table.
- Razors move between shelf and sink.
- Tablets move between nightstand and kitchen table.
